line: Crowley's Ten of Swords is the card for the third decan of Gemini, with the Sun as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Gemini.

quotes.quote: The Ten of Swords is called Ruin.
The card is also ruled by the Sun in Gemini

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: It shows reason run mad, ramshackle riot of soulless mechanism

sections.title: Crowley's group note on the Tens
sections.line: His note on the Tens says there is no planetary attribution to consider, yet each Ten names a planet in its sign. This page keeps the planet the chapter names.

quotes.quote: There is now no planetary attribution to consider.
